scope_report.examined_scope: Reviewed both new files in the PR: src/backoff.js (Backoff class with exponential-backoff-plus-jitter logic, constructor validation, canRetry, delayFor, next, reset) and test/backoff.test.js (8 tests exercising delay progression, capping, jitter, lifecycle, reset, and invalid configuration). Confirmed the repair delta that fixed finding 1 (off-by-one exponent) and the addition of tests that fixed finding 2. Checked correctness of the exponential formula, boundary behaviour of canRetry vs next, jitter application, constructor validation, and edge cases around attempt=0 and random()=0.
